svg.title: NAD+ by vein: what is sold vs. what has been tested against placebo
svg.desc: Log-scale chart of NAD+ doses in milligrams a day. Sold: an addiction detox protocol of 500 to 1,500 mg a day for about 10 days; a 750 mg six-hour drip described as a common clinic regimen; a 500 mg a day four-day loading dose; at-home shots starting at 50 to 100 mg. Tested against placebo: a single 500 mg drip in healthy adults in 2024 measuring tolerability and blood levels; 100 mg a day for 3 days in a 2026 safety test with 5 people per drip arm; 10 mg a day for 7 days in 180 heart patients in China; NADH 25 mg a day for 4 days in 9 Parkinson’s patients in 1994, with no difference from placebo. None of the placebo-controlled tests measured aging.
